18/// What a group XObject is used for, which decides its `/CS` under
19/// [`GroupColorSpace::Cmyk`].
20#[derive(Debug, Hash, Eq, PartialEq, Clone, Copy)]
21pub(crate) enum GroupRole {
22    /// Drawn in a page or another form: inherits the parent's blending space.
23    Content,
24    /// The `/G` of a soft mask: has no parent, so it names its blending space.
25    MaskSource,
26}
27
28#[derive(Debug, Hash, Eq, PartialEq)]
29struct Repr {
30    stream: Stream,
31    isolated: bool,
32    knockout: bool,
33    transparency_group_color_space: bool,
34    custom_bbox: Option<Rect>,
35    role: GroupRole,
36}
37
38#[derive(Debug, Hash, Clone, Eq, PartialEq)]
39pub(crate) struct XObject(Arc<Prehashed<Repr>>);
40
41impl XObject {
42    pub(crate) fn new(stream: Stream, isolated: bool, transparency_group_color_space: bool, custom_bbox: Option<Rect>) -> Self {
43        Self::with_role(stream, isolated, transparency_group_color_space, custom_bbox, GroupRole::Content)
44    }
45
46    /// A content group with the given group attributes.
47    pub(crate) fn group(stream: Stream, options: GroupOptions) -> Self {
48        Self::build(stream, options.isolated, options.knockout, false, None, GroupRole::Content)
49    }
50
51    pub(crate) fn with_role(
52        stream: Stream,
53        isolated: bool,
54        transparency_group_color_space: bool,
55        custom_bbox: Option<Rect>,
56        role: GroupRole,
57    ) -> Self {
58        Self::build(stream, isolated, false, transparency_group_color_space, custom_bbox, role)
59    }
60
61    fn build(
62        stream: Stream,
63        isolated: bool,
64        knockout: bool,
65        mut transparency_group_color_space: bool,
66        custom_bbox: Option<Rect>,
67        role: GroupRole,
68    ) -> Self {
69        // In case a mask was invoked in the content stream, we _always_ create
70        // a new transparency group. Please see <https://github.com/typst/typst/issues/5509>.
71        // Just to provide a brief explanation: I have not found any mention
72        // of a transparency group being required when using a soft mask in the
73        // PDF spec. However, Apple Preview (and only them!) have a weird bug
74        // where if you transform an XObject with a soft mask but not transparency
75        // group, the transform gets applied twice to the mask, resulting in
76        // rendering issues. Using a transparency group in this case seems to
77        // fix the issue.
78        // TODO: Apply group transparency to page as well.
79        transparency_group_color_space |= stream.uses_mask;
80
81        Self(Arc::new(Prehashed::new(Repr { stream, isolated, knockout, transparency_group_color_space, custom_bbox, role })))
82    }
83
84    pub(crate) fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
85        self.0.stream.is_empty()
86    }
87
88    pub(crate) fn bbox(&self) -> Rect {
89        self.0.custom_bbox.unwrap_or(self.0.stream.bbox)
90    }
91}

93impl Cacheable for XObject {
94    fn serialize(self, sc: &mut SerializeContext, chunk_container: &mut ChunkContainer, root_ref: Ref) {
95        let mut chunk = sc.new_chunk();
96
97        for validation_error in &self.0.stream.validation_errors {
98            sc.register_validation_error(validation_error.clone());
99        }
100
101        let use_transparency_group = self.0.isolated || self.0.knockout || self.0.transparency_group_color_space;
102
103        if use_transparency_group {
104            sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::Transparency(sc.location));
105        }
106
107        if use_transparency_group || sc.uses_transparency(&self.0.stream.resource_dictionary) {
108            sc.mark_transparent(root_ref);
109        }
110
111        let serialize_settings = sc.serialize_settings();
112
113        // "Ordinarily, the CS entry may be present only for isolated transparency groups (those
114        // for which I is true), and even then it is optional. However, this entry shall be present in
115        // the group attributes dictionary for any transparency group XObject that has no parent
116        // group or page from which to inherit."
117        //
118        // So while we don't technically always need to write it, let's just play it save
119        // and always add a group color space in case we have a transparency group.
120        //
121        // Under `GroupColorSpace::Cmyk`, content groups inherit the CMYK page group instead.
122        let transparency_group_cs = if !use_transparency_group {
123            None
124        } else {
125            match (serialize_settings.group_color_space, self.0.role) {
126                (GroupColorSpace::Rgb, _) => Some(sc.register_colorspace(chunk_container, rgb::color_space(serialize_settings.no_device_cs).into())),
127                (GroupColorSpace::Cmyk, GroupRole::Content) => None,
128                (GroupColorSpace::Cmyk, GroupRole::MaskSource) => Some(sc.mask_group_color_space(chunk_container)),
129            }
130        };
131
132        let x_object_stream = FilterStreamBuilder::new_from_content_stream(&self.0.stream.content, &serialize_settings).finish(&serialize_settings);
133        let mut x_object = chunk.form_xobject(root_ref, x_object_stream.encoded_data());
134        x_object_stream.write_filters(x_object.deref_mut().deref_mut());
135
136        self.0.stream.resource_dictionary.to_pdf_resources(&mut x_object, sc, &mut chunk_container.non_stream.resource_dictionaries);
137        x_object.bbox(self.0.custom_bbox.unwrap_or(self.0.stream.bbox).to_pdf_rect());
138
139        if use_transparency_group {
140            let mut group = x_object.group();
141            let transparency = group.transparency();
142
143            if self.0.isolated {
144                transparency.isolated(self.0.isolated);
145            }
146
147            if self.0.knockout {
148                transparency.knockout(true);
149            }
150
151            if let Some(transparency_group_cs) = transparency_group_cs {
152                write_group_color_space(transparency, transparency_group_cs);
153            }
154
155            transparency.finish();
156            group.finish();
157        }
158
159        x_object.finish();
160        chunk_container.streams.x_objects.push(chunk);
161    }
162}
163
164/// Write the `/CS` of a transparency group: DeviceRGB, DeviceCMYK, sRGB or the CMYK profile.
165pub(crate) fn write_group_color_space(group: &mut Group<'_>, cs: MaybeDeviceColorSpace) {
166    let pdf_cs = group.insert(Name(b"CS"));
167
168    match cs {
169        MaybeDeviceColorSpace::DeviceRgb => pdf_cs.primitive(DEVICE_RGB.to_pdf_name()),
170        MaybeDeviceColorSpace::DeviceCMYK => pdf_cs.primitive(DEVICE_CMYK.to_pdf_name()),
171        MaybeDeviceColorSpace::ColorSpace(cs) => pdf_cs.primitive(cs.get_ref()),
172        _ => unreachable!(),
173    }
174}

177    type Resource = resource::XObject;
